name: JOUF CEMENT

audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (23 files in inventory). JOUF CEMENT is Al Jouf Cement Company (Aljouf Cement) on every cover; Saudi riyals whole.
audit.method: All 23 files opened (cover, contact sheet or statement pages). Seventeen filings had BS, IS and CF read: image-statement files rendered and read by eye (FY2022 to FY2025, FY2022 interim-format issue, 2024 interims, Q1/H1 2025, Q1/H1 2026); text-layer filings (Q1 2022 to 9M 2022, Q1 2023, 9M 2025) read through tools/rows.py. Two English 2023 interims and four Arabic twins were not read. tools/check_transcripts.py passes for transcripts/3091.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR whole. BS totals, income statement through net profit and EPS and cash flow (CFO/CFI/CFF/net change/opening/closing cash) transcribed for FY2022, a second FY2022 year-end issue (interim format), FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 and Q1 2022, H1 2022, 9M 2022, Q1 2023, Q1/H1/9M 2024, Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1/H1 2026 (17 filings). All identities pass (BS equation, CF sum and roll, gross profit including the FY2025 inventory loss line, quarter-sum chains). 126 cross-filing differences are declared with both values. The material ones: (1) 2023 is shown as net profit 84,711,844 / revenue 301,488,335 (FY2023 original) and 37,678,330 / 269,284,152 (restated in FY2024, Note 32); (2) the 2024 interims were reported at Q1 12,450,956, H1 20,576,783, 9M 30,614,260 profit (revenue 82.0M, 160.0M, 234.9M) and re-presented in the 2025 filings as Q1 -5,794,571, H1 -15,865,063, 9M -27,725,962 (revenue 63.8M, 123.6M, 181.3M) while the FY2024 audit (-27,731,380, revenue 256,504,047) is on the restated basis, so Q4 2024 by subtraction is only valid from restated 9M; (3) FY2022 exists in two vintages (interim-format issue: net profit 32,498,490, assets 1,938,841,234; audited: 30,893,914, 1,960,442,831) and FY2021 comparatives moved from -148.8M to -92.6M loss; (4) cost-of-revenue and CFO reclassifications (FY2022 CFO 40,283,275 vs 65,272,475 in the FY2023 file; FY2024 cost of sales -240,668,980 vs -221,666,221 in the FY2025 file with the 2025 inventory loss shown separately); (5) 2025 and 2026 interim cost/selling reclassifications. The pipeline must choose vintages; this audit declares them.
